name: The New Forest Coven
summary: The mysterious group credited with launching the modern Wiccan revival.
lore: According to Gerald Gardner (the founder of modern Wicca), he was initiated into a secret, surviving coven in the New Forest region during the late 1930s. Led by a high priestess known in lore as 'Old Dorothy,' the group claimed to be practicing an unbroken lineage of ancient Pagan religion preserved through centuries of secrecy. In 1940, the coven reportedly performed 'Operation Cone of Power'—a massive collective ritual in the woods intended to psychically stop Hitler's forces from invading Britain.

events.title: Operation Cone of Power
events.narrative: Word reaches the coven that an invasion fleet is gathering across the Channel. The high priestess proposes the great rite: a cone of power raised in the woods to turn the enemy back.

choiceB.label: Recruit more hands for the rite

events.title: The Lyndhurst Grove-Keepers
events.narrative: The druids of Lyndhurst claim the ancient groves of the New Forest belong to them, and that your coven's rites are 'upstart Gardnerian inventions.' They challenge your right to meet in the woods.

choiceA.label: Out-rite them at the great oak

choiceB.label: Share the woods and grow quietly

events.title: The Brockenhurst Wild-Callers
events.narrative: The forest witches of Brockenhurst have been commanding the wild ponies and deer, leading them to trample a rival's crops. The landowner blames your coven by association.

choiceA.label: Bind the beasts back to the deep wood

choiceB.label: Let them run and grow your flock

events.title: The Ringwood River-Hags
events.narrative: The riverbank hags of Ringwood have dammed the Avon with woven reeds and are demanding tolls from passing boats. They offer your coven a share of the take.

choiceB.label: Break the dam and free the river

events.title: Old Dorothy's Succession
events.narrative: Old Dorothy, the high priestess, has grown frail. She asks the coven to choose her successor before the next sabbat. Two candidates stand forward, each with her own following.

choiceA.label: Back the elder candidate
choiceA.description: +150 Faith if the coven unites, −6 Followers if it splits

random.winMessage: The coven accepts the elder, and the succession is smooth. The line holds. +150 Faith.
random.lossMessage: The younger faction walks out into the night. Six followers are lost to the schism. −6 Followers.

events.title: Gardner Seeks Initiation
events.narrative: A curious man named Gerald Gardner arrives at the forest edge, asking to be initiated into 'the old religion.' He is a writer and collector, and some fear he will not keep the secrets.

choiceA.label: Initiate him and trust his discretion

choiceB.label: Turn him away and keep the secrets

events.title: The Full Moon Sabbat
events.narrative: The full moon rises over the clearing. The coven gathers skyclad for the sabbat, but a gamekeeper is known to patrol the wood's edge tonight.

choiceA.label: Hold the sabbat and ward the perimeter
choiceA.description: +200 Faith if unseen, −5 Followers if caught

random.winMessage: The warding holds. The sabbat passes in power and peace. +200 Faith.
random.lossMessage: The gamekeeper stumbles into the circle. Five followers are named in his report. −5 Followers.

choiceB.label: Move the sabbat to the deeper wood

events.title: The Blackout Rite
events.narrative: The war's blackout rules make the forest darker than it has been in centuries. The coven proposes a rite to use the darkness to strengthen the old ways.

events.title: A Hampshire Gentleman's Patronage
events.narrative: A gentleman scholar arrives at the forest edge with a heavy purse. 'I study the old folklore. I would fund your coven's work in exchange for records of your rites.'

choiceA.label: Accept his patronage and keep careful records

choiceB.label: Convert him to the old way

events.title: Wandering Seekers at the Edge
events.narrative: Three gaunt figures emerge from the trees at dusk, eyes wide with the long search. 'We have walked from London seeking the old religion. We are told it still lives in this forest.'

choiceB.label: Take their offerings and send them on
